messages:
maria: anyone seeing a customer report where Android clients get a silent close mid-stream after backgrounding the app? customer ACME-123, Pixel 5 Android 12. stream aborts and we get partial output, no retry id. logs show a short `RST` and then client re-opens.

arya: saw this in the ticket. repro steps from customer: 1) start long generation 2) background app for ~20-35s 3) resume -> client shows socket closed, then new connection, partial tokens missing. sometimes only when VPN is on.

eric: can you grab server side `x-request-id` and client logs (logcat + http debug)? also ask for a pcap if they can. natted mobile networks can RST sockets during suspend.

maria: pasted minimal logs below from customer's debug (redacted):
```
[2024-05-22 14:12:03] INFO outbound sse connection open id=r-abc123
[2024-05-22 14:12:28] WARN network detect app paused
[2024-05-22 14:12:48] ERROR socket closed EOF
[2024-05-22 14:12:49] INFO reconnect attempt new id=r-def456
```
customer also mentioned token refresh around 14:12:48; possible TTL race.

arya: hypothesis: Android's suspension tears the socket without delivering a clean EOF to the server. client library then reconnects and restarts the request (or resumes) but server already emitted partial chunks. With SSE that leaves the app with a truncated final message. Repro on emulator with battery saver enabled.

jamie: we've seen similar when keepalives are too sparse. server currently has 30s idle window. two things: (1) client-side heartbeat every 10s reduces chance of NAT/SIM RST, (2) server-side extend grace to 45s for mobile clients. both are safe short-term.

maria: customer asking if partial outputs are billable. support note: token usage is counted on served tokens; partials still count. propose a one-off credit while we investigate? finance ok with small customer credits for regressions.

eric: created INF-2041 to track. tagging @jamie for runtime changes and reconciling token accounting. please attach repro pcap and a minimal client repro.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: staging change applied: connection linger extended to 45s for canary. watch for reproductions. :eyes:

arya: QA can reproduce with Pixel 5 + ProtonVPN. steps: start stream, toggle VPN, background for ~30s, resume. recording + pcap uploaded to ticket.

maria: thanks. I'll reply to customer with interim workaround: enable client keepalive/heartbeat every 10s or prefer dedicated connection mode for heavy mobile sessions. also offering one-off credit pending root cause.

jamie: assigning INF-2041 to eng-runtime. tentative fix: make server tolerate in-flight partial-chunk retries by deduplicating token accounting when request id is re-sent within grace window. ETA: next week for canary tests.

maria: marking escalated -> level 2. will update ticket ACME-123 with repro link, pcap, and credit approval.

eric: thanks team. next actions: eng-runtime triage, QA confirm canary results, support send interim guidance and credit.
